summary: Marketing/service page of the London large-loan broker Silver Oak Capital for foreign national mortgages. According to the search summaries, the page defines a foreign national mortgage as a loan supporting non-UK citizens purchasing or refinancing UK property, describes typical features (overseas income, limited/thin UK credit history, enhanced AML/KYC compliance checks), names target groups (international executives relocating to the UK, UK expatriates returning from abroad), and explains the firm's approach: placing cases with lenders whose underwriting weighs economic factors such as bank statements and asset wealth rather than relying only on UK credit scoring, and documenting source of wealth and source of funds up front. No rates, LTVs, loan sizes, fees, deposits, timescales or accepted countries for this page were surfaced by the searches.
